items.title: Ladd McConkey: Expected to be available Sunday
items.text:
McConkey (back) is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Jets, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: In line to play Sunday
items.text:
Mayfield (foot/right thumb) is slated to play in Sunday's game against the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Mike Evans: On track to return Sunday
items.text:
Evans (Achilles) is reportedly ready to return to action Sunday night against the Vikings, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Out even for playoffs
items.text:
Nacua (knee) is expected to be sidelined 4-to-5 months after undergoing MCL surgery, which means he likely won't be able to return to action even if the Rams advance to the Super Bowl, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Expected to return for MNF
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt (groin) is slated to be activated from IR in time to play in Monday's game against the Bengals, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
